parameters.content:
## 18 - EGX Range Forecast

Next-session High/Low estimate (close +/- 1x ATR14) plus a backtested per-stock containment-rate accuracy: walking this stock's own history, on what % of past sessions did the ACTUAL next-session high/low both fall inside the band this same formula would have predicted the day before?

Self-sufficient: computes its own ATR14 from raw candles (same pattern as 05-egx-support-resistance), no dependency on 04 having run first.

A simple, transparent projection -- not a guarantee. Deliberately not tuned to look accurate.

parameters.query: SELECT id, symbol FROM stocks WHERE exchange = $1 AND active = TRUE ORDER BY symbol;
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS row_count FROM range_forecast;

INSERT INTO range_forecast (stock_id, trading_date, close, next_high_estimate, next_low_estimate, accuracy_pct, sample_size)
SELECT $1, r."tradingDate"::date, r.close, r."nextHighEstimate", r."nextLowEstimate", r."accuracyPct", r."sampleSize"
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS r("tradingDate" text, close numeric, "nextHighEstimate" numeric, "nextLowEstimate" numeric, "accuracyPct" numeric, "sampleSize" int)
ON CONFLICT (stock_id, trading_date) DO UPDATE SET
  close = EXCLUDED.close,
  next_high_estimate = EXCLUDED.next_high_estimate,
  next_low_estimate = EXCLUDED.next_low_estimate,
  accuracy_pct = EXCLUDED.accuracy_pct,
  sample_size = EXCLUDED.sample_size;
